newsitem.title: INDIA: Four killed as police open fire on violent mob.
newsitem.headline: Four killed as police open fire on violent mob.

text.p: At least four people were killed and several injured on Friday when police opened fire on a violent mob in India's commercial hub of Bombay, police officials said.
They said the situation was later brought under control at Ghatkopar, about 15 km (10 miles) from the city centre.
Police said trouble started when a statue of leader Bhimrao Ambedkar, known as the father of the Indian constitution, was found garlanded with shoes, viewed as an insulting gesture.
A mob surrounded the statue and pelted police with stones when they tried to push through the crowd to the statue.
The mob held up traffic on a busy highway during the morning rush hour and set fire to at least two private vehicles, police said.
Ambedkar is treated like a god by lower classes in India's rigid Hindu caste society.
